notes.title: SPRITE FIGHT DEMO RELEASE! 10/3
notes.notes:
[h1]SPRITE FIGHT DEMO[/h1]

While in development, Sprite Fight will be partaking in the October Steam Next Fest event, ranging from Oct.03 to Oct.10. ːsteamhappyː

[list]
[*] Sprite Fight is planned to implement many more weapons, maps, features, etc in the future, this is only the foundation on which it is going to be built.
[*] If you have any suggestions/questions for the future of Sprite Fight or the current demo build, please let me know, any critique would help push Sprite Fight for a more enjoyable launch in 2023.
[*] Since not in a finished state, bugs have been diminished to the best of my ability during this time. Still, inevitably there is going to be something I have missed, so if you encounter any bugs from minimal to game-breaking ones, please let me know so I can get them fixed ASAP.
[/list]

Thank you for trying out Sprite Fight and don't forget to wishlist for the official release in 2023!
